data.title: Iran to reopen Strait of Hormuz, can sell oil again, according to leaks of agreement with U.S. | CBC News
data.description: Iran will immediately take steps to reopen the Strait of Hormuz once a tentative deal with the U.S. to end the war is signed and will be allowed to sell its oil without restrictions, according to leaked copies of an interim agreement that officials say broadly matches the document.
